scope: Read-only review of final /tmp/endgame-thumb-package exports as of 2026-10-15 16:55 PDT

source_binding.single_scad: Stem=1; vendor files define MX=1, so all exports select the MX branch
source_binding.sculpted_long: keyID3 body rotated 90 degrees; StemRot90 produces a net 180-degree cross orientation, equivalent for an MX cross
source_binding.note: The MX socket is a recessed cross in a d5.4 x 3.0 mm sculpted boss or d5.5 x 3.75 mm convex boss. The removed legacy Choc bed is absent from the MX branch. Physical Choc V2 stem-fit remains untested.

case_clearance.method: Full-height axis-aligned cap-bounds rectangles, rotated to six PCB footprint angles, swept over case Z=1.6..20 mm and intersected with wired, XIAO, and nice!nano STEP cases; nice!nano keys shifted 2 mm outward per half.
case_clearance.limits: CAD envelope check; assembled switch, print tolerance, cap travel, and stem fit require a physical prototype.

grids.gate_design: Twelve 1.8 x 1.8 mm gates at local cap X=+/-4 mm, entering lower skirt from its inner Y edge; rail is 76 x 3 x 3 mm. Gate top is local Z=1.9 mm, below typing faces. Closest gate X edge is 3.1 mm from cap centre and its Y position is near the perimeter, outside the central d5.5 mm MX boss/socket region.

Endgame-sculpted-thumbs-4long-2small-gri.cleanup: After Manifold binary export, source/build.py retained the one positive-area, watertight grid component and removed two complete zero-area, two-facet sheet components caused by float32 rounding. No shape smoothing or decimation was applied.

grids.final_topology_check: Both binary STL grids are one watertight positive-volume body, Euler -10, with exactly two incident faces on every edge (sculpted 438867 edges; convex 442662 edges). All six single STLs are one watertight Euler-2 body each.

gate_to_typing_surface_check.method: Sampled vertical ray intersections on each repaired single STL over four potential gate-contact patches per cap, local abs(X)=3.1..4.9 mm and abs(Y)=6.8..7.2 mm, 5x5 grid per patch; compared outer surface Z with gate top local Z=1.9 mm.
gate_to_typing_surface_check.limit: Sampled geometry check; physical cut quality and fit remain untested.
